title.en: The Envoy Roster and the Old Treaties

desc.zh: 核对旧约里仍然有效的当事者与条款：谁是宗主、谁已自主、市场与预算各自如何承担，再决定谁有资格签署新的安排。
desc.en: Verify which parties and clauses of the old treaties still stand: who claims suzerainty, who governs itself, how markets and budgets each carry their share, and who may sign a new arrangement.

desc.zh: 使团、官署与港口检查都要从当前收入开支；每一家拟签国先付账、后签约，无钱者缩减条款，不赊欠也不预支。
desc.en: Missions, offices and port inspections are paid from current income; every prospective signatory pays before signing, trims the terms if it cannot, and neither borrows against the future nor collects in advance.

desc.zh: 履约阶段的关税、额外军费与期限都要在日常账目里检验：守约者留名，失约者如实记败，名分随实付而立废。
desc.en: Tariffs, extra levies and deadlines are tested against daily accounts: those who keep faith keep their standing, defaults are recorded as failures, and titles stand or fall with actual payment.

title.en: The Line Missing from the Old Treaty

desc.zh: 使团出发之前，旧约抄本与如今的关税、市场与账期对不上。提案国要逐项核对：谁仍称宗主，谁已自主任命官署，谁的市场与预算各自独立；已自主之邦不再写作必然属邦。
desc.en: Before the mission departs, the old treaty copy no longer matches today's tariffs, markets and ledgers. The proposing court verifies clause by clause who still claims suzerainty, who appoints its own offices, and whose market and budget stand apart; a self-governing country is no longer written down as a necessary dependent.

title.zh: 海商与礼官的两份名单
title.en: Two Rosters: Merchants and Rites Offices

desc.zh: 名单由谁来拟，决定承诺的范围：海商入议则口岸与账期一并上桌，礼官独办则礼制优先、商条从简。若对方已无有效当事者，本案无从谈判。
desc.en: Who drafts the roster decides the scope of the promise: with the sea merchants at the table, ports and ledgers come along; with the rites offices alone, ritual precedence narrows the commercial clauses. If the other side has no valid party left, there is nothing to negotiate.
